description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dikowita, Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 512007 (23/0410)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Plot Nos. 1:16 through 1:24) in Dikowita village, including detailed parcel information, ownership details (all owned by "The State"), and legal status. The content falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
